simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עׇזְנִיָּה (H5822) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עׇזְנִיָּה (ʻoznîyâh) means probably the sea-eagle (from its strength) First listed occurrence: Deut 14 12.

definitions.full: H5822. ozniyyah עָזְנִיָּה noun feminine (unclean) bird of prey , apparently akin to vulture (Now Archaeology i. 84, 116 ), named + מֶּרֶס נֶשֶׁר, Deut 14:12 ; Lev 11:13 (H); = osprey Tristr NHB 184 Dr Deut 14:12 (others vulture Di Lev 11:13 ) (√ unknown; conjectures see in Di; perhaps foreign word).
